headline: Silver Rate: Silver became 9,000 rupees more expensive in three days; today's silver rate in UP, Bihar and Delhi
summary: Silver prices in India climbed by 3,755 rupees to 2.25 lakh rupees on August 5, and have risen about 9,000 rupees over the past three days.
why: Silver is a precious and industrial metal, and its price affects jewellery demand, industrial users and investment flows in India, one of the largest consumer markets.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: The local Indian silver price rose, reflecting higher domestic silver prices.
